instruction: How to add a u32 filter with a mask for MAC address
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0x00112233 0xffffffff at -8 match u32 0x44556677 0xffffffff at -4 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for TCP destination port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 6 0xff match u16 80 0xffff at 2 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with IP and port combination
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 match ip dport 443 0xffff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a filter with a hash table for u32
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: prio 1 handle 1: u32 divisor 256 && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: prio 1 u32 ht 1: match ip src 10.0.0.1 hash key mask 0x000000ff at 12 link 1: && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: prio 1 u32 ht 1:1: match ip src 10.0.0.1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to show u32 filter details
output: tc filter show dev eth0 parent 1: prio 1

instruction: How to use tc qdisc to set up per-port queuing
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 10mbit && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dport 80 0xffff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for matching on IP fragment offset
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u16 0x2000 0x3fff at 6 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for matching on TOS/precedence
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u8 0x20 0xfc at 1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for matching on TCP flags
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u8 0x02 0xff at 33 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter that matches on 802.1Q VLAN ID
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol 802.1q prio 1 u32 match u16 0x0064 0x0fff at -2 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to use tc to shape traffic for a 802.1Q VLAN
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0.100 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev eth0.100 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 5mbit

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for matching on ICMP code
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff match u8 0 at 21 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a flower filter for VLAN protocol type
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower vlan_type 0x0800 action drop

instruction: How to filter by VLAN PCP with flower
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol 802.1q flower vlan_prio 5 action drop

instruction: How to add a tc filter that uses connmark
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 handle 1 connmark flowid 1:10

instruction: How to set up tc with IPset match
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 basic match 'ipset(blocklist src)' action drop

instruction: How to use tc-sample to sample packets at 1 every N
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.2 action sample rate 100 group 5  trunc 128

instruction: How to set the sample truncation size
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0 0 action sample rate 10 group 1 trunc 256

instruction: How to add police action to tc filter
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 action police rate 1mbit burst 10k conform-exceed drop/continue

instruction: How to set up a two-rate policer in tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0 0 action police rate 10mbit burst 10k mtu 1500 peakrate 20mbit pburst 20k conform-exceed drop/ok

instruction: How to add a simple tc filter that drops all traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0 0 action drop

instruction: How to attach tc filter with a specific handle
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 handle 0x10 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a qdisc on a bonded interface
output: tc qdisc add dev bond0 root handle 1: htb default 30

instruction: How to shape traffic on a bridge interface
output: tc qdisc add dev br0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev br0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 5mbit

instruction: How to use tc with netem on a virtual bridge port
output: tc qdisc add dev veth0 root netem delay 100ms loss 5%
